body:
Deal: roborock Qrevo L Pro Robot Vacuum and Mop, 18,500Pa Powerful Suc… $609 (RRP $1,699) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[SeanConnery] I wonder if there's ever been a person on planet Earth who has willingly bought a robot vac at RRP.
[Maxxjet] Honestly, Roborock presents itself as a premium brand in this space but they stopped software updates in just over 2 years … and now my machine is getting disoriented often lol
[OneFly] Any recommendations for a fully carpeted house with cats? I don’t need the mopping function; I just want a robot vacuum with good vacuuming performance.
[kojihama] I bought this in mid year sales same price and it’s great for that. I have 2 cats and run it once a day on schedule.
[Thermal] Agreed, showing as $849 for me also (while being logged in with Prime).
